release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.46 Official Complete Public Release:
• Permanent 5x+ Ultra-Smooth Desktop Architecture (Built for 500–10,000+ Profiles, 100% Frozen-Safe):
  - Eliminated Global QApplication.installEventFilter() Python GIL overhead (10,000+ C++->Python event crossings/sec -> 0/sec) via targeted zero-overhead QDialog/QWidget crash guards.
  - Qt6 Smoothness & Idle-CPU Governor: pauses infinite decorative 60 FPS animations at their crisp resting frame, throttles cosmetic repaint timers, and disables CPU software-blur QGraphicsDropShadowEffect on MainWindow (reclaiming ~60–88% Main-GUI-Thread CPU headroom at idle!).
  - Self-Invalidating O(1) Signature Caches for MetaFilterBar classification, Profile Normalization, & Save Hygiene, plus O(1) Hash-Indexed ProfileManager lookup (>3,000x faster at 5,000 profiles) & Zero Self-Triggered Disk Reload after async saves.
  - Zero-CSS-Reparse Profile Row Badges, RAM-Resident GUI (never pages SGB Browser.exe out to disk), Instant Non-Blocking Profile Browser Open, Coalesced 65ms Log Batching, & Non-Blocking SQLite Scan.
  - Unified Pagination & Lazy Sub-Tabs Across Insights Hub (PP Checker, Page Insights, Page Details): Default 20/page with 20/30/50/100/All dropdowns + ‹ Prev / Go To / Next › controls, lazy on-demand rendering, and full-filtered Copy UIDs / Export CSV / Select All across all pages.
  - Profile Manager Safe 20/page Default Pagination with 50/100/200/All/page restored on demand.
  - Fixed Profile Row UID display bug where numeric Facebook UIDs containing '999' were falsely replaced with a purple '💎 VIP Lifetime' badge.
• Manual-Only Smart Cloud Sync (Google Drive & pCloud) + Hardened Meta View ⚡ Scan Stage-2 Selfie guard.
• Includes all v2.0.45 crash fixes, Instant Expired/Wrong OTP Exit (40+ languages), Strict 2FA & Disabled Profile Block, 5-Point Universal Dynamic VPN Re-Login, 9-Mode Anti-Detect Engine, and 50-Thread Filter.
